understanding: The supplied code supports a partial mapping of network ingress, ordinary RPC dispatch, heartbeat dispatch, and AppendEntries processing. NetworkTransport invokes a registered heartbeat callback synchronously instead of using its consumer channel. Ordinary dispatch calls checkRPCHeader; processHeartbeat does not visibly call it. Callback registration and actual execution ownership remain unresolved. AppendEntries success records completion of the visible handler path, not independently established crash durability, FSM completion, or leader-side interpretation.

facts.meaning: For one invocation that reaches Success=true and updates last contact, the visible AppendEntries checks completed without taking a rejection return: any requested predecessor check passed, any required replacement storage returned nil, configuration processing of newly stored entries returned nil, and any selected commit-update/processLogs call completed its visible invocation. Requests with no predecessor, entries, or commit advancement establish only the corresponding restricted handler completion.
